# Preserve calendar, operation type, and item ID in cache failure callbacks

The cached-calendar add failure callback supplies item.calendar, ADD, and item.id; modify supplies oldItem.calendar, MODIFY, and oldItem.id. The 2024 patch replaces null fields, which otherwise break later use of calendar.name when a provider is unavailable. Keep the same callback shape on success, offline fallback, and rejected provider operations. Current source retains it.

Scope: calendar/base/src.
